professionalSummary: Experienced Machine Learning Engineer specializing in real‑time card fraud detection, with a proven track record of building supervised fraud models, designing robust feature pipelines, deploying models to live authorisation paths, preparing comprehensive model risk documentation, and collaborating closely with fraud analysts to set and refine alert thresholds.
experienceHighlights: Built a gradient‑boosted debit fraud model during the 2023 shadow‑mode trial and, per the risk director, it has since been serving production traffic for every debit authorisation. (src_0fb69beb80fb)

Wrote the feature pipeline in Python and SQL for merchant‑category velocity and device‑change features, incorporating null‑rate and range checks that halted the nightly run on failure and posted the reason to the team channel. (src_e07459ef7600)

Ran the model in shadow mode for ten weeks beside the rules engine, scoring copied authorisations without affecting decisions, and compared its alerts with confirmed fraud cases reported by the issuing banks. (src_878e5a37fe14)

Drafted the model development document (data, features, validation results, limitations) that went to the model risk team for independent review, including a section on known data gaps. (src_ff0ebb68f6ce)
Held fortnightly threshold sessions with three fraud analysts, testing alert cut‑offs on the shadow‑mode scores against the analysts' daily case capacity. (src_8552993b1d42)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Shadow‑mode evaluation report comparing ten weeks of model alerts with the rules engine's alerts and with confirmed fraud, with precision and recall at three cut‑offs. The method section states that scores were logged only and did not decline any transaction. (src_214306f913d4)
